 President Trump says he thinks it will take Iran 25 years to rebuild itself after the US-Israel war, adding he “would rather not destroy the country if possible, but maybe I’ll have to – you’ll know soon enough”.
 Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi holds separate calls with his counterparts in Saudi Arabia, Oman and Qatar amid mounting fears of a US attack.
